newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Finnlines 1996 profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Finnlines 1996 profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 408 million markka median forecast for shipping company Finnlines Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax:.
(EPS forecasts by 13 analysts, profit forecasts by 14).
The results are due on February 7.
In 1995, Finnlines posted a 319 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.

Analysts' forecasts include an extraordinary gain of 118 million markka booked by Finnlines in its Jan-Aug accounts as operating income. Finnlines has said it will book the gain as operating income also in its full-year financial statement.
For Finnlines's full-year 1997 profit, nine of the 14 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 360 million markka (mean 359 million) in a 327-400 million markka range.

Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, AG Private Bankers, Alfred Berg, Aktia, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
